title: Joint total alkaline phosphatase–phosphorus encoding for independent-cycle albuminuria prediction
abstract: Adding a sex-specific total alkaline phosphatase–phosphorus spline surface changed independent-cycle weighted log-UACR MSE from 0.798517 to 0.799727 (delta +0.001210; joint PSU-bootstrap95% [-0.003524,+0.069543]). The registered improvement criterion was not met. Exploratory transfer, not untouched confirmation, causal evidence or clinical utility.
